mapper.insert: INSERT INTO combination_review (owner_account_id, title, input_revision, same_project, same_cost, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ownerAccountId}, #{title}, #{inputRevision}, #{sameProject}, #{sameCost}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT p.review_id, p.position, p.source_code, p.source_program_id, p.sub_program_id, p.application_submitted, p.selected, p.commitment_submitted, p.agreement_signed, p.execution_status, p.funding_received FROM combination_review_program p INNER JOIN combination_review r ON r.id = p.review_id WHERE r.id = #{reviewId} AND r.owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} ORDER BY p.position
SELECT id FROM combination_review WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM combination_review_run WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM combination_review WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId}
